title: A reminder opened on the phone is not re-sent on Telegram
goal: Opening the push notification marks the delivery opened; the Telegram copy is cancelled or never sent
acceptance: The service worker reports a notification click to the service, which marks the delivery opened
An opened reminder produces no Telegram message; an unopened one still falls back (F-004-T09)
privacy: Neutral fixtures and invented data only; no secrets, tokens, endpoints or personal data in Git.
validation: Every test reading live.js, dashboard.js or web/src
escalation: A material scope or effort increase goes to the owner

effort.basis: Estimated 2026-11-25: one authenticated endpoint, the click handler and the cancel rule. Not a measurement.
